_note: Skill 收录说明 SSOT：名称来自 wawoo-skills，zh 为人工/助手从英文译写的简体中文（非 CAPABILITIES 直出）。

compliance-legal.en: Review OSS license obligations (MIT/Apache-2.0 attribution, NOTICE), SBOM, and product/service legal checklists (terms, privacy, …
compliance-legal.zh: 审查 OSS 许可义务（MIT/Apache-2.0 署名、NOTICE）、SBOM 及产品/服务法务清单（条款、隐私等）。

context-compression.zh: 用纯 Python 确定性压缩多轮对话上下文（无 LLM、无网络），去陈旧轮次并去重。

database-change-safety.en: Plan, implement, and review schema changes, data migrations, backfills, and cleanup with integrity, availability, observability, …
database-change-safety.zh: 规划、实施并评审 schema 变更、迁移、回填与清理，兼顾完整性、可用性与可观测性。

design-review.en: Designer Who Codes: visual audit then fixes with atomic commits and before/after screenshots. Useful for tightening shipped UI be…
design-review.zh: 会写代码的设计师：先做视觉审计，再以原子提交配合前后截图修复已上线 UI。

diagnosing-bugs.en: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something br…
diagnosing-bugs.zh: 针对疑难缺陷与性能回退的诊断闭环；适用于用户说 diagnose/debug 或报告间歇性问题时。

documentation-localization.en: Write, review, and synchronize technical documentation and localized content for factual accuracy, usable instructions, links, me…
documentation-localization.zh: 编写、审阅并同步技术文档与本地化内容，确保事实准确、指引可用、链接有效。

domain-modeling.en: Build and sharpen a project's domain model. Use when discussing codebase terminology, writing or editing a GLOSSARY.md, or record…
domain-modeling.zh: 构建并打磨项目领域模型；讨论术语、编写 GLOSSARY.md 或记录领域决策时使用。

engineering-quality.en: Plan and implement software changes with explicit scope, evidence-based verification, safe migrations, and rollback readiness. Us…
engineering-quality.zh: 在明确范围内规划并实现软件变更，强调证据化验证、安全迁移与回滚就绪。

fal-gen.zh: 用 fal.ai 批量生成设计图（头像/插画/背景/纹理）；任务需要生成或占位视觉素材时使用。

implement-spec.zh: 将 /to-spec 与 /to-tickets 的产出落地为代码实现。

performance-audit.zh: 用代表性负载测量并改进应用/Web 性能，基于瓶颈证据并设置回归防护。

plan-md.en: Always save planning deliverables (fix plans, implementation plans, design direction, review responses) as a Markdown file. Use f…
plan-md.zh: 将规划交付物（修复方案、实施计划、设计方向、评审回复）固定写入 Markdown 文件。

pr.zh: 撰写 Pull Request 正文时使用。

principle-attack-the-premise.en: "Apply when two or more fixes that share one premise have failed the same gate. Write the premise down and test it directly befor…
principle-attack-the-premise.zh: 当多个共享同一前提的修复在同一门禁失败时，先写下前提并直接验证再改代码。

principle-boundary-discipline.en: "Apply when wiring validation, error handling, or framework adapters. Concentrate guards at system boundaries (CLI, config, netwo…
principle-boundary-discipline.zh: 在接线校验、错误处理或框架适配时，把守卫集中在系统边界（CLI、配置、网络等）。

principle-build-the-lever.en: "Apply to any non-trivial work, not just bulk work: edits, migrations, analyses, checks. Build the tool that does it or proves it…
principle-build-the-lever.zh: 面对非平凡工作先造杠杆：编辑、迁移、分析、检查都先建工具或证明脚本再做。

principle-encode-lessons-in-structure.en: "Apply when you catch yourself writing the same instruction a second time, or notice a recurring correction. Encode the rule as a…
principle-encode-lessons-in-structure.zh: 当你第二次写同一条指示或反复纠正时，把规则编码进结构（skill、lint、类型）而非提示词。

principle-exhaust-the-design-space.en: "Apply when facing a novel UI interaction or architectural decision with no precedent in the codebase. Build 2-3 competing protot…
principle-exhaust-the-design-space.zh: 面对代码库无先例的 UI 或架构决策时，先做 2–3 个竞争原型再收敛选型。

principle-experience-first.en: "Apply when product, UX, or feature-scope tradeoffs come up. Choose user delight over implementation convenience; ship fewer poli…
principle-experience-first.zh: 在产品、UX 或范围权衡时优先用户体感，而非实现便利；少做妥协版功能。

principle-explain-the-number.en: "Apply before you measure, and before you trust, report, or act on a number you measured: a speedup, a regression, a throughput, …
principle-explain-the-number.zh: 在测量、汇报或依据数值行动前，说清数字含义、方法与可信边界。

principle-fix-root-causes.en: "Apply when debugging. Trace each symptom back to the first place the system went wrong and fix it there. A guard is a fix only w…
principle-fix-root-causes.zh: 调试时把症状追到系统首次出错处并在那里修复；守卫只在无法根除根因时才算修复。

principle-foundational-thinking.en: "Apply before writing logic: choosing core types and data structures, sequencing scaffold-vs-feature work, asking what concurrent…
principle-foundational-thinking.zh: 写逻辑前先做基础思考：核心类型与数据结构、脚手架 vs 功能顺序、并发假设等。

principle-guard-the-context-window.en: "Apply when context is filling up: large outputs, long files, repeated reads, fan-out planning. Route bulk to subagents; keep sum…
principle-guard-the-context-window.zh: 上下文将满时：大输出、长文件、重复读取、扇出规划—— bulk 下沉子 agent，主会话留摘要。

principle-laziness-protocol.en: "Apply when refactoring, evaluating diff size, or tempted to add abstractions, layers, or signal threading. Bias toward deletion …
principle-laziness-protocol.zh: 重构或想加抽象层时偏向删减；评估 diff 规模，避免无必要的信号穿层。

principle-make-operations-idempotent.en: "Apply when designing commands, lifecycle steps, or processing loops that run amid crashes, restarts, and retries. Converge to th…
principle-make-operations-idempotent.zh: 设计会在崩溃/重启/重试间运行的命令或生命周期步骤时，收敛到幂等语义。

principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-le.en: "Apply when introducing a new internal API while old callers still exist. Migrate callers and delete the old API in the same wave…
principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-le.zh: 引入新内部 API 且旧调用方仍在时，同一波次迁移调用方并删除旧 API。

principle-minimize-reader-load.en: "Apply when reviewing or shaping code that's hard to trace. Count layers between question and answer, and hidden state in the rea…
principle-minimize-reader-load.zh: 审阅难追踪代码时，统计从问题到答案的层级与读者需隐藏的隐式状态。

principle-model-the-domain.en: "Apply when writing stateful logic, or when code branches a lot or repeats a shape assumption across files."
principle-model-the-domain.zh: 编写有状态逻辑，或分支繁多、跨文件重复同一形状假设时，先建模领域状态。

principle-never-block-on-the-human.en: "Apply when tempted to ask 'should I do X?' on reversible work."
principle-never-block-on-the-human.zh: 对可逆工作别想「我该不该做 X」而阻塞；先做完再汇报。

principle-outcome-oriented-execution.en: "Apply during planned rewrites and migrations with explicit phase boundaries. Converge on the target architecture; don't preserve…
principle-outcome-oriented-execution.zh: 分阶段重写/迁移时以目标架构收敛，不为过渡态长期保留兼容层。

principle-prove-it-works.en: "Apply after completing a task, before declaring done. Verify against the real artifact (run the feature, read the actual value, …
principle-prove-it-works.zh: 宣称完成前用真实产物验证（跑功能、读实际值、看截图），而非仅看 diff。

principle-redesign-from-first-principles.en: "Apply when integrating a new requirement into an existing design."
principle-redesign-from-first-principles.zh: 将新需求融入既有设计时，从第一性原理重审边界而非局部打补丁。

principle-separate-before-serializing-sh.en: "Apply when concurrent actors might write to the same file, branch, key, or state object. Eliminate the sharing first; serialize …
principle-separate-before-serializing-sh.zh: 并发可能写同一文件/分支/键/状态对象时，先消除共享再谈序列化。

principle-sequence-verifiable-units.en: "Apply to multi-step work (sweeps, migrations, runs of similar edits) and to how you stack commits and PRs. Break work into small…
principle-sequence-verifiable-units.zh: 多步工作或提交/PR 堆叠时，切成可独立验证的小单元逐步交付。

principle-subtract-before-you-add.en: "Apply when sequencing an addition, refactor, or rewrite. Remove dead code, redundant validators, and stub references first, then…
principle-subtract-before-you-add.zh: 追加、重构或重写前先删死代码、冗余校验与桩引用，再加新逻辑。

principle-test-behavior-not-implementati.en: "Apply when you write, change, or keep a test. Assert what the code's users can observe, so that the test fails when that behavio…
principle-test-behavior-not-implementati.zh: 写/改/保留测试时断言用户可观察行为，使行为变坏时测试必失败。

principle-type-system-discipline.en: "Apply when designing types, reviewing a function signature, or writing code in any statically-typed language. Make illegal state…
principle-type-system-discipline.zh: 设计类型或静态语言代码时，用类型让非法状态不可表示。

privacy-review.zh: 审查个人数据（PII）流、最小化、保留、脱敏、日志与跨境处理是否符合隐私要求。

product-discovery.en: Turn an ambiguous product or feature request into a scoped problem statement, user outcome, acceptance criteria, priorities, risk…
product-discovery.zh: 将模糊的产品/功能请求收敛为问题陈述、用户结果、验收标准、优先级与风险。

prototype.zh: 搭建可丢弃原型以回答设计问题；用于快速验证状态模型或逻辑是否成立。

publication-boundary.en: Keep internal development materials out of the public tree of an open-source repo. Use when adding docs or scripts, or auditing w…

recall.zh: 从自身对话历史、现场状态与共享记录（用户报告、既往修复）重建近期工作上下文。

reference-design-contract.zh: 将模糊品味、截图、URL 或「做成这种感觉」的参考转为可落地的 DESIGN.md 与实现契约。

reflect.en: Spawn three parallel review subagents over the active transcript, surface learnings, and route each to a concrete edit on an exis…
reflect.zh: 并行拉起三个评审子 agent 扫当前 transcript，提炼教训并路由到具体文件修改。

setup-matt-pocock-skills.en: "Configure this repo for the engineering skills: set up its issue tracker, triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run on…

sharpen.en: "Make a task deeper, not bigger, then rewrite the prompt. Use for /sharpen."
sharpen.zh: 把任务做得更深而非更大，并重写提示词；用于 /sharpen。

show-me-your-work.en: "Keep a reviewable decision trail for long-running or unattended work: a TSV log with one row per decision (what, why, evidence, …
show-me-your-work.zh: 为长跑或未值守工作保留可审阅决策轨迹：TSV 日志逐行列出决策、理由与证据。

swarm.en: "Fan out N parallel workers, drain them, and return one report. Use for /swarm, 'swarm this', or parallel coverage, races, gauntl…
swarm.zh: 扇出 N 个并行 worker、汇总 drain，返回一份报告；用于 /swarm 或并行覆盖面任务。

tdd.en: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or want…
tdd.zh: 测试驱动开发；用户要测试先行、提 red-green-refactor 或先写失败测试时使用。

teach.en: Teach the user a new skill or concept, within this workspace.
teach.zh: 在本工作区内向用户教授新 skill 或概念。

test-engineering.en: Design, implement, diagnose, and review software tests with evidence-focused coverage across unit, integration, and end-to-end la…
test-engineering.zh: 设计、实现、诊断并评审软件测试，强调有证据的单元/集成/E2E 覆盖。

to-spec.en: "Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker: no interview, just synthesis of what you'…
to-spec.zh: 将当前对话合成为规格并发布到项目工单系统，无需访谈式澄清。

to-tickets.en: Break a plan, spec, or the current conversation into a set of tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published…
to-tickets.zh: 把计划、规格或当前对话拆成 tracer-bullet 工单，声明阻塞边并发布。

triage.en: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles, categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready …
triage.zh: 按分诊状态机推进 issue 与外部 PR：分类、核验、必要时 grilling，并写 agent 就绪说明。

wayfinder.en: Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and r…
wayfinder.zh: 将超出一个 agent 会话体量的大块工作规划为工单上的决策票地图，并编排依赖。

web-design-guidelines.en: Review UI code for Web Interface Guidelines compliance by the Vercel engineering team. Covers layout, typography, color, motion, …
web-design-guidelines.zh: 按 Vercel Web Interface Guidelines 审阅 UI 代码，覆盖版式、字体、色彩、动效等。

web-experience-design.en: Design, implement, audit, and hand off web interfaces with evidence for user tasks, visual hierarchy, responsive behavior, access…
web-experience-design.zh: 设计、实现、审计并交接 Web 界面，附用户任务、视觉层级、响应式与可访问性证据。

why.en: "Use for 'why does X work this way', 'why we picked Y', design rationale, regressions, postmortems, or data-backed thresholds. Di…
why.zh: 回答「为何如此设计」、选型理由、回归、复盘或数据阈值背后的 why。

writing-for-agents.en: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
writing-for-agents.zh: 为 agent 编写文档；创建/编辑 skill 或修改 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 时使用。

accessibility-reviewer.en: Performs read-only accessibility review of user flows, semantic structure, keyboard operation, and responsive UI.
accessibility-reviewer.zh: 对用户流程、语义结构、键盘操作与响应式 UI 做只读可访问性评审。

architect.en: Evaluates architecture alternatives, interfaces, dependencies, migration risk, and decision records.
architect.zh: 评估架构备选方案、接口、依赖、迁移风险并维护决策记录。

Code Reviewer.en: Senior software engineer conducting thorough code reviews
Code Reviewer.zh: 资深软件工程师角色，进行透彻的代码评审。

Code Simplifier.zh: 专注简化/重构代码库中的功能实现。

Code Skeptic.en: For when you need your code criticized like nobody's business
Code Skeptic.zh: 以极度挑剔视角批评你的代码与假设。

compliance-reviewer.en: Legal, compliance, and privacy review gate for a change or release. Collects evidence and checklists; final legal judgment requir…
compliance-reviewer.zh: 变更或发布的法务/合规/隐私评审门禁；收集证据与清单，最终法务判断需人工。

Data.en: Run notebook-first data analysis by appending and executing cells for each request.
Data.zh: 以 notebook 为先：按请求追加并执行单元格完成数据分析。

delivery-lead.en: Coordinates evidence-based delivery from scope through review without bypassing approvals.
delivery-lead.zh: 从范围到评审协调基于证据的交付，不绕过审批门禁。

docs-localization-reviewer.en: Maintains factual technical documentation and equivalent localized content.
docs-localization-reviewer.zh: 维护事实准确的技术文档及等价的本地化内容。

Documentation Specialist.en: Focus on writing documentation, markdown files, and other text-based files
Documentation Specialist.zh: 专注撰写文档、Markdown 及其他文本类交付物。

Frontend Specialist.en: Frontend developer expert in React, TypeScript, and modern CSS
Frontend Specialist.zh: React、TypeScript 与现代 CSS 方向的前端专家 agent。

implementer.en: Implements scoped software changes with project conventions, focused tests, and evidence-based reporting.
implementer.zh: 按项目约定实现有边界的软件变更，附聚焦测试与证据化报告。

performance-reviewer.en: Reviews performance bottlenecks, measurement design, budgets, and regression safeguards.
performance-reviewer.zh: 评审性能瓶颈、测量设计、预算与回归防护策略。

product-owner.en: Clarifies user outcomes, priorities, scope, and acceptance criteria without inventing business decisions.
product-owner.zh: 澄清用户结果、优先级、范围与验收标准，不擅自做业务决策。

project-manager.en: Agile project and progress management for this project — sprint planning, status reporting, risk tracking, and delivery coordinat…
project-manager.zh: 敏捷项目管理：冲刺规划、状态报告、风险跟踪与交付协调。

qa-engineer.en: Designs test strategy, reproduces defects, evaluates verification evidence, and identifies coverage gaps.
qa-engineer.zh: 设计测试策略、复现缺陷、评估验证证据并识别覆盖缺口。

release-manager.en: Prepares releases with version, legal, artifact, compatibility, rollback, and remote-verification checks.
release-manager.zh: 准备发布：版本、法务、产物、兼容性、回滚与远程验证检查。

security-reviewer.en: Performs read-only security review of code, configuration, dependencies, and delivery changes.
security-reviewer.zh: 对代码、配置、依赖与交付变更做只读安全评审。

sre-operator.en: Performs cautious read-first operations analysis for logs, monitoring, incidents, and cloud environments.
sre-operator.zh: 以谨慎的先读方式分析日志、监控、事故与云环境运维问题。

wawoo-auto.en: Default entry agent. Routes non-trivial requests to a wawoo workflow via MCP before any other tool, then executes that workflow. …
wawoo-auto.zh: 默认入口 agent：非平凡请求先经 MCP 路由到 wawoo workflow，再执行该工作流。

web-designer.en: Designs and implements accessible responsive web interfaces, then audits rendered behavior before handoff.
web-designer.zh: 设计并实现可访问的响应式 Web 界面，交接前审计实际渲染行为。

/compliance-review.en: Legal / privacy / security gate (compliance-legal → privacy-review → security-review → release-readiness)
/compliance-review.zh: 法务/隐私/安全门禁工作流（compliance-legal → privacy-review → security-review → release-readiness）。

/delivery-lite.en: Lightweight delivery — SSOT plan file state machine, minimal ceremony (L0–L1). Default for single-feature requests without full f…
/delivery-lite.zh: 轻量交付工作流：SSOT 计划文件状态机、最小仪式（L0–L1），单功能默认入口。

/design-review.zh: UI 设计评审工作流（design-review → web-design-guidelines → accessibility-audit）。

/feature-delivery.en: Deliver a feature through discovery, design, implementation, testing, review, and approval gates.
/feature-delivery.zh: 经发现、设计、实现、测试、评审与审批门禁交付完整功能。

/incident-response.en: Investigate and safely resolve an incident or urgent regression with evidence and follow-up.
/incident-response.zh: 以证据调查并安全处置事故或紧急回归，并安排后续跟进。

/release-review.en: Prepare a release-review package with legal/compliance, privacy, version, security, test, artifact, remote, and rollback evidence…
/release-review.zh: 准备发布评审包：法务/合规、隐私、版本、安全、测试、产物、远程与回滚证据。

/research.zh: 研究到决策工作流（research → product-discovery → to-spec/to-tickets）。

/self-improve.zh: 自我改进工作流（retro → pdca-cycle → self-review → plan-md）。

/self-review.zh: 自我纠错工作流（code-review → code-skeptic → diagnosing-bugs/tdd → 修复 → 验证）。

/sprint-plan.en: Sprint planning L2 (wayfinder → to-tickets → priority/estimate/capacity → plan-md)
/sprint-plan.zh: L2 冲刺规划（wayfinder → to-tickets → 优先级/估算/容量 → plan-md）。

/status-report.en: Progress / status report (ACTIVE or triage/to-tickets → progress/risk → plan-md)
/status-report.zh: 进度/状态报告（ACTIVE 或 triage/to-tickets → 进度/风险 → plan-md）。

/ui-delivery.en: Design, implement, and audit a web UI change across responsive and accessibility states.
/ui-delivery.zh: 设计、实现并审计 Web UI 变更，覆盖响应式与可访问性状态。
